chapterTitle: Chapter 30 Orbitals and Organic Chemistry: Pericyclic Reactions
title: Problem 30-11

pages.text: PROBLEM 30-11 When a 2,6-disubstituted allyl phenyl ether is heated in an attempted Claisen rearrangement, migration occurs to give the p-allyl product as the result of two sequential pericyclic reactions. Explain.
